title: Ultimate FPS MAX
description: ⚡ No magic FPS boost — but zero freezes, zero stutters, zero lag. 45+ optimization mods that stabilize your game, cut CPU/RAM usage and keep everything smooth even at 32+ chunk render distance. Fabric 1.21.1 🚀
body:
# ⚡ Ultimate FPS MAX — Smooth Performance Modpack

**Minecraft 1.21.1 | Fabric | 45+ Mods**

---

## 🎯 What does this modpack actually do?

**Important:** This modpack does **not** magically double your FPS counter. If you already get 120 FPS in vanilla Minecraft, you will still get ~120 FPS with this pack.

What it **does** do:
- ✅ **Eliminates freezes and stutters** — no more sudden drops when loading new chunks
- - ✅ **Reduces CPU and RAM usage** — your system runs cooler and more efficiently
- - ✅ **Stabilizes your FPS** — keeps it consistent instead of spiking up and down
- - ✅ **Scales better under load** — lets you push further distances, bigger worlds, more entities without lag
- - ✅ **Faster world loading** — chunks generate and load much quicker
- - ✅ **Better multiplayer performance** — reduced ping impact, smoother experience on servers

---

## 🔍 Who is this for?

| Situation | Benefit |
|-----------|---------|
| You get freezes every few seconds | Gone ✅ |
| You want to use 32+ chunk render distance | Now possible ✅ |
| You play on large multiplayer servers | Much smoother ✅ |
| Your CPU/RAM is under heavy load | Significantly reduced ✅ |
| You have a low-end PC | More playable experience ✅ |
| You already have 200+ FPS | Stays stable instead of fluctuating ✅ |

---

## 📦 What's included (45+ mods)

### 🖥️ Rendering Optimizations
- **Sodium** — Complete rendering rewrite, the foundation of this pack
- - **ImmediatelyFast** — Speeds up immediate mode rendering
- - **Entity Culling** — Skips rendering entities you can't see
- - **More Culling** — Extends culling to more block types
- - **Enhanced Block Entities** — Faster rendering for chests, signs, etc.
- - **Particle Core** — Optimized particle rendering

### 🧠 CPU & Memory Optimizations
- **Lithium** — Deep game logic optimizations
- - **FerriteCore** — Cuts RAM usage significantly
- - **ModernFix** — Fixes performance issues in the base game
- - **BadOptimizations** — Additional micro-optimizations
- - **ThreadTweak** — Better multi-core CPU usage
- - **Faster Random** — Faster random number generation

### 🌍 World & Chunk Optimizations
- **Ksyxis** — Faster world loading (removes spawn chunks)
- - **Chunky** — Pre-generates chunks to avoid in-game freezes
- - **ScalableLux** — Async lighting engine
- - **Alternate Current** — Optimized redstone
- - **Structure Layout Optimizer** — Faster structure generation

### 🎮 Gameplay Performance
- **Dynamic FPS** — Reduces resource usage when tabbed out
- - **FastQuit** — Instant world quit, no waiting
- - **Let Me Despawn** — Smarter mob despawning
- - **Clumps** — Groups XP orbs to reduce entity count
- - **Does It Tick?** — Controls which entities actually tick
- - **Get It Together Drops** — Merges item drops

### 🌐 Network & Multiplayer
- **Krypton** — Network stack optimization
- - **Very Many Players** — Designed for high player count servers
- - **Packet Fixer** — Fixes oversized packet issues
- - **Raknetify** — Replaces TCP with RakNet (better ping)
- - **Fast IP Ping** — Faster server list ping

### 🛠️ QoL & Misc
- **No Telemetry** — Disables Mojang data collection
- - **Debugify** — Fixes known Minecraft bugs
- - **Language Reload** — Faster language switching
- - **Remove Reloading Screen** — Resource packs load in background
- - **Shut Up GL Error** — Removes harmless OpenGL spam
- - **FastChest** — Faster chest rendering
- - **Sodium Extra** — Additional Sodium settings

---

## ⚙️ System Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.1
- - **Mod Loader:** Fabric
- - **Java:** 21+
- - **RAM:** 2GB minimum, 4GB recommended
- - **GPU:** Any (no RTX/ray tracing required)

---

## 📊 Real-world impact

The real gains show up when you **push your game harder:**
- Run 32 chunk render distance → stays smooth
- - Enter a village with 50 mobs → no freeze
- - Join a server with 100+ players → playable
- - Open a large chest room → no stutter

---
